links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT responses to the same UCF patient questions with no reading-level instruction (also benchmarked against the UCF materials)
links.outcome: Readability of patient education responses (six validated readability formulae)
links.effect: Default ChatGPT was significantly worse than UCF on readability across all 6 topics (all P < .001). Adjusted ChatGPT readability typically surpassed UCF and met the recommended level for 2 topics. No numerical scores were given in the abstract.
links.quote: Conversely, adjusted ChatGPT readability typically surpassed UCF, even meeting the recommended level for 2 topics.
